en: A black-and-white postcard view of a small European town taken from an elevated, tree-framed vantage point. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with a tall spire rising above a cluster of gabled houses and rooftops. Trees and gardens fill the foreground, and the town extends into the background under a cloudy sky. In the lower left corner, the caption 'Dahlen i. Sa.' is printed.
